title: 万象归环

generationRuns.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: 1024×1536 vertical tarot World “All Things Return to the Ring” master candidate, exact single-card painting.
Input image: reference image, identity reference only.
Primary request: Create one midnight-blue fantasy tarot painting. One adult dancer in violet-gold fabric stands/dances centered within exactly one vertical oval gold-leaf star ring. Her toe visibly contacts one continuous small water platform/ripple. Four distinct guardian space-window scenes provide depth but leave the dancer clear: lion upper-left, bull upper-right, winged human lower-left, eagle lower-right. Thin star tracks connect behind the main figure only and must not cover her face, hands, ring, or guardians. Sparse tiny star-leaves only.
Style/medium: collectible hand-painted fantasy card, night blue, violet gold, silver white, restrained fine-track and leaf narrow frame.
Composition/framing: 2:3 vertical full-card, central dancer and oval, four protected corners; no crop, no collage.
Constraints: exactly one dancer, exactly one oval star ring, exactly four stated guardians in exact positions. No duplicate figures/rings/platforms, no additional people or animals, no rotation illusion, no typography, text, letters, digits, logo, watermark, rainbow glare, checkerboard.

provenanceRecovery.evidence: historical actual tool call and completed generation event; workspace file matches original output SHA256

Delete ALL people, ALL animals, ALL main foreground props, ALL foreground support platforms/floors and their contact shadows, ALL floating foreground decoration, and the entire outer border/corner ornaments. NO people or animals may remain, including silhouettes and reflections. Reconstruct the distant environment naturally behind deleted objects. Keep only the distant landscape/architecture and original atmosphere. Do not add a second copy of the support ground. Opaque RGB image. Specific removed connected group: 舞者、椭圆主环、四角形象固定；脚尖水面需维持接触，仅附加无肖像细轨可缓转；本主题支撑归属：脚尖接触平台、主环和四角整体，附加细轨另记. Environment ownership details: 除主体完整连接组、独立前景和固定框外的环境；必须补全清除区域，不保留重复主体或接触阴影。. Highest priority: an EMPTY clean environment, absolutely no protagonists or foreground props. Remove ALL decorative symbols attached to the margins, including the upper and lower crescents, attached stars, corner ornaments and rectangular border strokes. Fill those pixels with continuous natural environment textures. The result is a full-bleed clean background with absolutely NO card furniture.
